lines.text: The king could not sleep, so he had the Book of Records read to him, and it showed Mordecai exposed a plot.
The king learned nothing had been done for Mordecai, and his attendants said Hathach was standing in the court.
Haman thought the king meant him, so he proposed a royal robe, a horse, and a parade through the city square.
The king told Haman to take the robe and horse to Memucan, and Haman paraded him through the city square.
Haman rushed home with his head covered in grief, and the king's eunuchs soon rushed him to Esther's banquet.
